title: [ML] stop using isAllowedByLicense for model license checks

timeline.message: [ML] stop using isAllowedByLicense for model license checks
timeline.author: Benjamin Trent

timeline.body:
For trained models, there are both basic and platinum licenses allowed. 

We should track the feature usage check based on the license operation mode instead of using the underlying isAllowedByLicense.

closes: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/79811
@rjernst is this required for 8.0.0? Or is 8.1.0 OK?
8.1.0 is fine, there is no rush. This is just a general direction for the license state to simplify it.

timeline.author: Benjamin Trent

timeline.body: Is this actually needed? Basic is the default, so this fallback case will always be true. I think it can simple be removed.  Note that LicensedFeature is meant for tracking Basic+ features.
I think this switch could be turned into an if/else. It’s either platinum, or else it is basic.
